title: Drive to Ysyk-Kol via Burana & Kok-Moinok
desc: You leave Bishkek for Ysyk-Kol, the Pearl of Central Asia, starting with the ancient Burana Tower and then a homemade Dungan lunch with a local family in Iskra Village, a warm introduction to the country's mix of cultures.
Along the way you stop at the Kok-Moinok canyons for a short walk, then follow the southern shore of the lake to Bokonbaev, where a guesthouse welcomes you for the night.

title: South shore: eagle hunter, canyons & Jety-Oguz
desc: The morning begins with an eagle-hunter demonstration by a local Kyrgyz hunter, a close look at a tradition kept alive for generations. From there you explore the colour-streaked Fairy-Tale Canyons.

Lunch is at the home of mountaineer Lyubov Danichkina in Tamga Village, and the afternoon takes in the Barskoon Waterfalls and the red rock of the Jety-Oguz Valley before you reach Karakol for the night.
meals: Breakfast & lunch at guesthouse, dinner at restaurant

title: Off-road to Altyn-Arashan
desc: Today you climb into the mountains aboard a sturdy Soviet UAZ truck, following a river through pine forest up to the Altyn-Arashan gorge. Lunch waits at a guesthouse on arrival.

The afternoon is for soaking in the natural hot springs, walking the trails, or simply resting with Peak Palatka rising to 5200 m above the valley. There's an optional ride if you'd like one, and dinner is served in a traditional yurt where you spend the night.
meals: Breakfast at hotel, lunch & dinner at guesthouse

title: Drive back to Bishkek
desc: A last quiet morning in Altyn-Arashan, with the mountains all around, before the UAZ carries you back down to Karakol for lunch at a local restaurant.
The road home runs along the northern shore of Ysyk-Kol, the Pearl of Central Asia, with long lake views before you reach Bishkek in the evening.
meals: Breakfast at hotel, lunch at restaurant
